en: the pixiu, the beast that keeps wealth

legend.zh: 貔貅是金色的神兽。它很喜欢吃金子。人们说，它只吃，不拉，所以家里的钱不会走。很多银行和商店都有一个貔貅。
legend.en: The pixiu is a golden beast that loves to eat gold. People say it only eats and never lets anything out, so wealth stays in the house — many banks and shops keep one.

befriend.text: 我喜欢金色的东西。你有吗？
